categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Touches src/musig.cpp, src/musig.h, and cryptographic helper primitives wrapping libsecp256k1.
categories.rationale: Prevents crashes from uninitialized memory reaching libsecp256k1 during partial signing. The description notes that MuSig2SecNonce previously evaluated as valid before nonce generation, allowing uninitialized memory to reach secp256k1_musig_partial_sign and trigger library assertion crashes.
